mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an ultra-easing monetary environment that reduces equity discount rates and stimulates risk asset demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% triggers a recessionary labor market signal that compresses corporate profit margins and reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 9.0, or the signal's predictive power vanishes in 3-year rolling windows (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production below 86.0 and housing starts below 460.0 units signals a deepening supply contraction that triggers equity market panic, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when INDPRO < 86.0 but HOUST > 460.0 (or vice versa) and SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time, or the interaction effect vanishes (IC < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: GDP contraction below 11,350 billion dollars in the prior quarter signals a severe demand collapse that triggers fiscal stimulus expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 55% of GDPC1 < 11350.0 instances, or the signal's predictive power collapses in 3-year windows (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation below 2.0% combined with FEDFUNDS at 0.18% signals ample monetary policy space for rate cuts, compressing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when CPIAUCSL < 2.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.18 but SPX 5d returns are negative > 55% of the time, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls decline exceeding 100,000 persons in the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of PAYEMS < 131000.0 instances, or the signal's predictive power is absent in 3-year rolling windows (Rank IC < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 470.0 units and retail sales (RSAFS) decline exceeding 10,000 million dollars signals a demand misalignment where housing recovery outpaces consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when HOUST > 470.0 but RSAFS < 317000.0 and SPX returns are negative > 55% of the time, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 86.0 in the prior month signals a supply shock that triggers inventory destocking and equity market volatility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 55% of INDPRO < 86.0 instances, or the signal's predictive power vanishes in 3-year rolling windows (Rank IC < 0.02).
